image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a stack of baby bibs. The primary subject is a pale pink fabric bib with a rounded shape, featuring embroidered yellow flowers and green leaves, along with small scattered floral motifs. It has a visible neck hole with pink piping/trim. Behind it are other bibs: one white with a printed design (possibly a bird or character) and a pocket, and a dark brown polka-dotted bib at the bottom right with a green snap button.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embroidery threads lack distinct individual strand definition, appearing slightly 'painted' or fused into the fabric rather than raised stitches. This is a common AI artifact in fine textile details.
The pink piping around the neck hole varies inconsistently in width and seems to merge slightly with the main fabric in areas, lacking the crisp, separate geometry of real sewn trim.
The pocket seam on the white bib curves unnaturally and doesn't align perfectly with the perspective of the bib's body, suggesting slight geometric warping.
